say:1:1610245001:0.text: *Yawn*... You're finally back... I've already been working overtime for two hours and seventeen minutes.
say:1:1610245001:0.source_cn: 呼啊啊，你终于回来啦……我已经多加班了两小时十七分钟。
say:1:1610245001:0.male: *Yawn*... You're finally back... I've already been working overtime for two hours and seventeen minutes.
say:1:1610245001:0.female: *Yawn*... You're finally back... I've already been working overtime for two hours and seventeen minutes.

say:2:1610245002:0.text: It's time to rest... Good luck in the selection tomorrow...
say:2:1610245002:0.source_cn: 该是休息时间了……选拔加油……哦……
say:2:1610245002:0.male: It's time to rest... Good luck in the selection tomorrow...
say:2:1610245002:0.female: It's time to rest... Good luck in the selection tomorrow...

say:4:1610245003:0.text: With eyes half-shut, Contess finishes speaking and drops to the lounge floor, reverting to the rulebook. Pressing your ear close, you hear faint snores.
say:4:1610245003:0.source_cn: 康缇丝几乎是闭着眼睛和你说完了话，随后一头栽向休息室地...
say:4:1610245003:0.male: With eyes half-shut, Contess finishes speaking and drops to the lounge floor, reverting to the rulebook. Pressing your ear close, you hear faint snores.
say:4:1610245003:0.female: With eyes half-shut, Contess finishes speaking and drops to the lounge floor, reverting to the rulebook. Pressing your ear close, you hear faint snores.

say:5:1610245004:0.text: You return the rulebook to where it belongs. It's time to get some rest. You'll need your strength for tomorrow's selection.
say:5:1610245004:0.source_cn: 将校规放回原处后，你也该养精蓄锐，准备迎接明日的正式选拔了。
say:5:1610245004:0.male: You return the rulebook to where it belongs. It's time to get some rest. You'll need your strength for tomorrow's selection.
say:5:1610245004:0.female: You return the rulebook to where it belongs. It's time to get some rest. You'll need your strength for tomorrow's selection.

narration:7:1610245005:0.text: You sink into the warm blanket left for you.
narration:7:1610245005:0.source_cn: 你陷入休息室温暖的毯子中
narration:7:1610245005:0.male: You sink into the warm blanket left for you.
narration:7:1610245005:0.female: You sink into the warm blanket left for you.

narration:10:1610245007:0.text: A strange sound of flapping wings can be heard in the darkness, and then...
narration:10:1610245007:0.source_cn: 昏暗中传来奇特的振翅声，随后——

say:11:1610245008:0.text: It's time to wake up, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. The commencement of the selection is at hand. Your punctual attendance is required.
say:11:1610245008:0.male: It's time to wake up, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. The commencement of the selection is at hand. Your punctual attendance is required.
say:11:1610245008:0.female: It's time to wake up, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. The commencement of the selection is at hand. Your punctual attendance is required.

say:12:1610245009:0.text: According to the selection rules, I cannot appear at the trials. However, I will use another set of eyes to observe the events with you.
say:12:1610245009:0.source_cn: 依照选拔章程，我无法在选拔赛上出现。但我会用另一双眼睛...
say:12:1610245009:0.male: According to the selection rules, I cannot appear at the trials. However, I will use another set of eyes to observe the events with you.
say:12:1610245009:0.female: According to the selection rules, I cannot appear at the trials. However, I will use another set of eyes to observe the events with you.

narration:15:1610245011:0.text: And just like that, your eyes flutter open.
narration:15:1610245011:0.male: And just like that, your eyes flutter open.
narration:15:1610245011:0.female: And just like that, your eyes flutter open.
